# Statement of Contribution

In Assignment 1, Jonas Hautamäki Bengston was primarily responsible for
both the code implementation and the written report. Kerstin Arbring
was responsible for the code implementation and report for Assignment 2,
while Jonas Danielsson was responsible for the corresponding work in
Assignment 3.

Following the initial completion of Assignments 1–3, the code and
written reports were circulated among the group members for one round of
refinement and one round of review of text. Assignment 4 (Theory) was
drafted collaboratively by all three group members. The results and
conclusions from all assignments were discussed collectively.
